obligation: G003 — root-cause the HCLI failure mode: every recent .hcli receipt is status:failed / kind:error with empty operations and NO error text.

defect_1.title: Unconstrained reasoning exhausts the completion budget before the JSON is emitted
defect_1.mechanism: engine.py::_call_model posts model/messages/temperature/max_tokens and nothing else. No reasoning-budget control and no response_format. Qwen3 emits its reasoning first. On a real 7257-token director mission it never reaches the JSON object before HCLI_MODEL_TOKENS (default 6500) is spent, so the reply is truncated (finish_reason='length') and unparseable. The engine then raises the generic 'Model did not return a valid structured JSON object', which is the ONLY line in every failing epoch log.
defect_1.arithmetic_that_first_suggested_it: 6500 completion tokens / ~314 s observed per failed production call = 20.7 tok/s, which is exactly this machine's single-decoder rate. The call was not erroring or hanging; it was decoding to the budget.
defect_1.why_it_was_never_caught: On a small prompt every arm succeeds. The controlled probe shows baseline passing in ~9.6 s on a toy calc.py goal and failing at 6500 tokens on the real mission. A test written against the toy case cannot see this.
defect_1.counter_intuitive_finding: A JSON schema ALONE does not fix it. The 'schema' arm still burned 6500 tokens and still failed: constrained decoding forces the SHAPE of the output but the model reasons inside the string fields. Disabling thinking is the necessary condition; the schema is a structural guarantee on top, not a substitute.
defect_1.fix: chat_template_kwargs={'enable_thinking': False} on structured calls (requires the server to run with --jinja, else it is silently ignored), plus response_format json_schema, plus recording finish_reason so a length truncation can never again present as a mystery.

defect_2.title: Failure receipts record no cause
defect_2.mechanism: engine.py::execute's `except BaseException` builds a result carrying "error": str(exc), but _write_receipt constructs the receipt from a fixed key list that never copies `error`. The failure therefore reaches disk as kind:'error' / status:'failed' with empty operations, empty tests, null validation and no message at all.
defect_2.aggravating: str(exc) is the empty string for KeyboardInterrupt and for several timeout exceptions, so copying the message alone would still sometimes record nothing. The exception TYPE and a truncated traceback must be recorded as well.

measured.meaning: _write_receipt builds the receipt from a fixed key list that never copies `error`, so a failure is recorded with no cause. Separately, str(exc) is '' for KeyboardInterrupt and several timeouts, so even copying it would sometimes record nothing — the exception TYPE must be recorded too.

defect_2.fix: carry error, error_type and a truncated traceback onto failed/cancelled receipts.

production_evidence.note_on_fingerprint: A single distinct fingerprint across every recorded epoch is a CYCLE / NO_PROGRESS signature: the stage hash never moved, so nothing the director did changed the tree.
